chapter_title_en: A Cold Welcome on Heavenly Market Street
chapter_keywords: a record of a mortal's journey to immortality
chapter_seo_title: Han Li Returns to the World: A Cold Welcome on Heavenly Market Street
chapter_meta_description: Han Li completes his first Three Revolutions revolution and steps back into the cultivation world. But Starseeker City’s Heavenly Market Street has more than rare treasures—it has eyes. And they’re watching.
og_title: Han Li Returns to the World: A Cold Welcome on Heavenly Market Street
og_description: Han Li completes his first Three Revolutions revolution and steps back into the cultivation world. But Starseeker City’s Heavenly Market Street has more than rare treasures—it has eyes.
twitter_title: Han Li Returns to the World
twitter_description: Han Li emerges from twenty years of seclusion and immediately faces a social tribulation on Heavenly Market Street.

lore_anchors.definition: A high-risk cultivation method that compresses the cultivator’s true essence through multiple revolutions, achieving purer qi and tighter bottlenecks at the cost of immense time and pain.
A massive, jade-like pavilion floating thirty zhang above Heavenly Market Street in Starseeker City, treated as a landmark of awe for first-time visitors.
The bustling northern commercial district of Starseeker City, surrounded by a protective barrier and containing hundreds of shops for cultivator trade.
A petite, sweet-faced rogue cultivator who approaches Han Li and Curly Soul with an offer of guidance, more interested in the high-level cultivator than the man himself.
A strikingly beautiful rogue cultivator companion of Yan Li, whose interest is also clearly focused on Curly Soul as a potential asset or patron.
A cultivator without a sect or major family backing, forced to trade, hunt, and ally independently for survival and advancement.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Han Li suppress his cultivation the moment he is approached?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He is a Mortal Stream protagonist who treats even a friendly greeting as a potential intelligence leak, so he deliberately masks his power to reduce his perceived value as a target.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why do Yan Li and Yuan Yao approach Han Li and Curly Soul?
cultural_notes_faq.a: They are rogue cultivators trying to attach themselves to a powerful Foundation Establishment senior (Curly Soul) for protection, resources, or future networking—a common survival tactic in the cultivation world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Curly Soul a real person?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No, Curly Soul is a soulless doppelgänger created from Han Li’s control over a modified corpse body, but he is treated by outsiders as a separate cultivator of high cultivation.
